__DEPRECATED__: RETIRED 2026-07-08. This file is NO LONGER a ruleset and must NOT be deployed.
The blocks that used to live here (workspaces, team_invites, sharedDecks) have been
MERGED into the single canonical, deployable ruleset: `database-rules.json` (same repo).
That file is the ONE source of truth and is what is live on the
`echonest-live-survey-default-rtdb` database. Edit + deploy THAT file, not this one.
Deploy the canonical rules with the Firebase Console (Realtime Database -> Rules ->
paste database-rules.json -> Publish) or via the REST endpoint
PUT https://echonest-live-survey-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/.settings/rules.json
with an OAuth token minted from the Admin service account.

so the 5/25 cap holds there, not in the rules.
